description: Hermes Agent 0.23.2 with the hermes-otel 1.33.0 plugin: one read_file call (hello.txt), then the answer; traces with prompts.
notes: The telemetry is hermes-otel's, a community plugin installed into Hermes's own environment (D-IN-29 item 7; `cetra agents setup` has no hermes-agent target), configured by .hermes/hermes_otel.yaml with cetra's endpoint and key. The provider is Hermes's custom provider, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint pointed at the mock with the mock key; the spans therefore show provider custom and no cost. Hermes probes the provider beside its turns (POST /api/show, GET /v1/models/gpt-4o-mini, GET /api/v1/models), which the mock answers without a turn. The read tool of the base toolset takes a path relative to the repo. Hermes wraps each model call in an llm.<model> span with no tokens (a chain in cetra's rules) around the api.<model> call that carries them. gen_ai.conversation.id is Hermes's session id, which differs between runs, so it is volatile. The system prompt embeds the repo's git state (the init commit hash differs per run), carried by gen_ai.input.messages and input.value; llm.response.duration_ms and hermes.api.ttfc_ms are measured, so the check ignores their values.
